{"reason": "False-arbitration-rate 0.714 (20/28) drives the low fitness; 6 of 8 failure rows have confidence below 0.7 (0.44–0.67). Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) gates low-trust events. Recall is 1.0, giving headroom above the 0.8 business gate, so this should cut false arbitrations without recall penalties.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
